exposure: 5C psychological scales (confidence, complacency, constraints, calculation, collective responsibility)
cohort: 1218 Jordanian healthcare workers, including nurses (33.8%), physicians (30.1%), medical technicians (14.9%), pharmacists (13.2%), and dentists (7.1%).
finding: Higher influenza vaccine acceptance and uptake were associated with male sex, being a physician or dentist, older age, higher income, higher confidence and collective responsibility, and lower complacency, constraints, calculation, and vaccine conspiracy beliefs.
